深色模式：跟著你的手機自動切換（The Crowd Tape 小教學 32/35）

網站會跟隨你手機或電腦的設定：白天是白底，開了深色模式就自動變成黑底。
晚上躺在床上看也不刺眼。

怎麼用：在 iPhone「設定 > 螢幕顯示與亮度」選「深色」，再打開網站。

reddit.body:
Dark mode that follows your phone (The Crowd Tape tip 32/35)

The site follows your phone or computer setting: light by day, and black automatically when dark mode is on.
Easy on the eyes at night.

How: Turn on Dark in iPhone Settings > Display & Brightness, then open the site.
